speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Three shipments secured. Both uplinks are down. Regional patrols have lost their shared targeting feed.

speaker: AURA
text: Listen. No coordinates. No orders. Just a little room between the noise. I can work with that.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Enjoy it while it lasts. Their eyes are down, not their weapons. I’ve marked a way out.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Send the recovered power back toward the neighborhoods. They’ve been keeping people cold to keep these fences burning.

speaker: TITAN
text: Put those crates on the service line. We hauled enough weight for their machines. Let it carry something useful.

speaker: KAITO
text: They’ll come looking for this depot. Make sure the supplies leave before we do.

speaker: AURA
text: A short signal. No names, no coordinates. Just this: the checkpoint is open, and you are not alone.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: The route reaches the Border Fortress. I can get us to its approaches. Getting through that wall is another matter.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: The fortress runs on its own power. Its guns will still be waiting.

speaker: KAITO
text: Then we go together. This city has waited long enough.
